name: model-router
description: Routes every Claude Code turn to the cheapest model that can do it well (Haiku lookups, Sonnet execution, Opus decisions), lets the model escalate itself, routes subagents too, keeps a warm cache when switching would cost more, and compares costs with the same work tokens at Opus prices. Classification runs on your own Anthropic account; no third party sees your prompts.

language.title: Reason language
language.description: Language of the routing reason and the price comparison in the band (en = English, zh = Simplified Chinese)

mainRouting.title: Route the main conversation
mainRouting.description: On (the default): every turn you start is classified and runs on the cheapest model that fits. Off: subagent-only mode, the low-risk way to start. The main thread is left on your own model (Fable included), and subagent routing, escalation, Fable blocking for subagents and the meter keep working. A Fable session gets this treatment by itself while Respect a Fable session is on.

blockFable.title: Block Fable
blockFable.description: On (the default): Fable never runs on a subagent; a subagent that asks for it, or would inherit it from a Fable session, runs on your Decision model instead. On the main conversation Fable is only moved to the Decision model when Respect a Fable session is off and main routing is on. Off: Fable is left alone everywhere; a subagent still never runs above its parent.

respectFableSession.title: Respect a Fable session
respectFableSession.description: On (the default): when you choose Fable as the session model, the router leaves your conversation on Fable: no classification, no move to another model (a #model in a message or a pin still wins). Its subagents are still routed to the cheaper models, and the session is still counted. Sessions on any other model are routed as usual. Off: a Fable session is routed like any other, so with Block Fable on Fable never answers on the main conversation.

haikuModel.title: Lookup model
haikuModel.description: Model for lookups. haiku (the default) is an alias that follows the newest Haiku model; a full id such as claude-haiku-5-5 pins one model, and if your account reports it as not found the tier runs on haiku instead (checked daily)

sonnetModel.title: Execution model
sonnetModel.description: Model for execution. sonnet (the default) is an alias that follows the newest Sonnet model; a full id such as claude-sonnet-5-5 pins one model, and if your account reports it as not found the tier runs on sonnet instead (checked daily)

opusModel.title: Decision model
opusModel.description: Model for decisions. opus (the default) is an alias that follows the newest Opus model; a full id such as claude-opus-5-5 pins one model, and if your account reports it as not found the tier runs on opus instead (checked daily)

reviewModel.title: Decision reviewer
reviewModel.description: Optional: reviews Opus's decisions with a model id available on your account, only if it exists there (checked daily). The reviewer is sent your request and Opus's answer unmasked. Empty (the default) turns the review off. Fable 5.1 is never used.

idleCompactMinutes.title: Idle compact after (minutes)
idleCompactMinutes.description: 0 (the default) is off. 1 to 55: after this many idle minutes at the prompt, compact the main conversation while the 1-hour prompt cache is still warm, so coming back later rewrites a small context instead of a huge one. Only when the context is at least the Compact minimum context and no background agent is running; a new prompt cancels it. The timer moves forward when needed to leave a 3-minute cache margin plus 30 seconds of scheduling headroom, with at least 1 minute at the prompt. Values outside 1 to 55 count as off.

compactMinContext.title: Compact minimum context (tokens)
compactMinContext.description: The idle compact only runs when the main context is at least this many tokens; a smaller one is cheap to rewrite and not worth a summary.

checkpointHints.title: Suggest task-boundary checkpoints
checkpointHints.description: Suggest /model-router checkpoint after a main turn when the context is large enough and estimated future cache-read savings exceed the summary cost. Never compacts automatically. Off by default.

shrinkToolOutput.title: Reduce large tool output (characters)
shrinkToolOutput.description: 0 (the default) and values below 20000 are off. Otherwise reduce large Bash and MCP text logs, preserving diagnostics and archiving the exact original locally. Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, code and diffs are left alone. fetch_output retrieves archived slices within the same character cap.

compactAtContext.title: Compact at context (tokens)
compactAtContext.description: 0 (the default) is off; below 100000 also counts as off (the engine's own auto-compact window starts there). Otherwise, when a main turn ends with the context at or above this many tokens (for example 200000), compact it between turns while the cache is warm, so each later step does not re-read a huge cache.

learnFromCorrections.title: Act on and record routing corrections
learnFromCorrections.description: On (the default): when you correct a reply's routing (/model-router wrong <tier> or the band's Should have been buttons) the rest of the session is pinned to that tier's model until /model-router unpin, and the masked prompt snippet is stored locally (up to 40 per session per day, kept 30 days), as is one when the model escalates itself to a bigger model than the classifier chose (that never pins). Corrections are an evaluation set for revising the classifier prompt offline; they are never sent to the classifier. Off: no buttons, nothing is recorded and nothing is pinned by corrections; stored corrections stay on disk until /model-router corrections clear.

weeklyPacing.title: Weekly usage pacing
weeklyPacing.description: warn (the default): the status line shows when your weekly usage runs ahead of an even pace, with one toast per weekly window. steer: also routes a decision the classifier was unsure of to Sonnet while ahead (a warm Opus cache, #model, a pin and a sure decision are never moved). off: no pacing text, toast or routing change. /model-router pacing <mode> overrides this and persists.
